source.title: Arden - Oak Sage
source.name: Arden
source.description: A wise Mage who can summon lightning to attack enemies under control effects.

skills.name: Force of Nature

description.raw: Arden selects a tile and casts lightning strikes on all surrounding enemies within 2 tiles, dealing 160% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage and creating dark cloud that cover the area for 7s. The dark cloud will repeatedly strike controlled enemies below with lightning, dealing 80% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage each time. An enemy can only be struck once every 2s. Arden prioritizes selecting the tile with the most surrounding enemies when casting the lightning strikes.
active: Arden selects a tile and casts lightning strikes on all surrounding enemies within 2 tiles, dealing 160% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage and creating dark cloud that cover the area for 7s.
The dark cloud will repeatedly strike controlled enemies below with lightning, dealing 80% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage each time.
An enemy can only be struck once every 2s.
Arden prioritizes selecting the tile with the most surrounding enemies when casting the lightning strikes.

text: Deals 180% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage with the first lightning strike, and 90% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage with the subsequent lightning strike.
Deals 190% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage with the first lightning strike, and 95% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage with the subsequent lightning strike.
Deals 200% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage with the first lightning strike, and 100% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage with the subsequent lightning strike.
Deals 210% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage with the first lightning strike, and 110% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage with the subsequent lightning strike.

skills.description_lite: Arden creates a dark cloud that strikes enemies with lightning for several seconds. Enemies are subjected to more lightning strikes when controlled.

skills.name: Entangling Vines

description.raw: Arden summons vines to entangle 2 closest enemies for 2 + 0.25 (SP-based)s, making them unable to move or act while dealing 50% (ATK-based) damage every 1s. Arden prioritizes enemies under the dark cloud.
active: Arden summons vines to entangle 2 closest enemies for 2 + 0.25 (SP-based)s, making them unable to move or act while dealing 50% (ATK-based) damage every 1s.
Arden prioritizes enemies under the dark cloud.

skills.description_lite: Arden summons vines to entangle 2 enemies and deals continuous damage to them.

skills.name: Nature's Resilience

description.raw: Arden recovers 12 + 3 (SP-based) Energy whenever a non-summoned enemy is controlled. This effect can trigger once per enemy every 2s.
active: Arden recovers 12 + 3 (SP-based) Energy whenever a non-summoned enemy is controlled.
This effect can trigger once per enemy every 2s.

skills.description_lite: Arden recovers Energy for himself when enemies are controlled.

skills.name: Spring Thunderstorm

description.raw: Arden casts Entangling Vines on all enemies under the dark cloud once after casting Force of Nature.
active: Arden casts Entangling Vines on all enemies under the dark cloud once after casting Force of Nature.

text: Increases the range of Force of Nature to 3 tiles.
Increases the duration of Entangling Vines to 3s.
Increases the duration of Entangling Vines to 3.5s.

skills.description_lite: Arden entangles enemies under the dark cloud immediately after casting Force of Nature.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: Arden reduces the lightning strike interval of Force of Nature for the same enemy by 1s.
active: Arden reduces the lightning strike interval of Force of Nature for the same enemy by 1s.

skills.description_lite: Arden reduces the lightning strike interval of Force of Nature for the same enemy.
